role: String catalog localizing the watch Info.plist purpose strings.
toplevel: sourceLanguage en. CFBundleDisplayName and CFBundleName have only English (state new; CFBundleName 'EmuquWatch Watch App' comes from the generated plist). NSBluetoothAlways/NSHealthShare/NSHealthUpdate UsageDescription have all 17 localizations; English values equal the watch Info.plist strings and the sampled German text matches the current English content. Included in the watch bundle through the file-system-synchronized group. Correction: the CFBundleName entry is not a leftover. It is Xcode's extraction of the CFBundleName that GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE injects from PRODUCT_NAME, marked shouldTranslate false.
